_about: M3-ENV-02 post-import rules for the Brine Shoals kit (game/core/import/brine_shoals_kit_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). The same LOD table as the Haluna kit and HalunaDresser's defaults (which still override them at runtime with the layout's values); every glTF slot maps to the kit's own materials folder. The kit exports no -col proxies yet; walk collision is m2-slice's (swap-in notes in docs/kb/handoffs/live/env-art.md).
